name: Insolent's Castigation
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds
description: Pressure plates trigger hidden mauls in the walls of the pits that swing up to slam creatures and knock them off the span.
disable: DC 30 Society check (expert) to locate the hidden deactivation switch or DC 33 Thievery check (expert) to jam the mechanics on the span.
reset: The trap resets over the course of the round and is ready to swing again 1 round later. It can be manually reset if Disabled.

offensiveAbilities.name: Castigate the Disrespectful
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves onto the span.

Effect The mauls swing up, making an attack against the triggering creature.
